issue.title: Flaky test_archive_publication_order_survives_inverted_scheduling[host_first-2] under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
`tests/test_plan_approval_launch_reliability_integration.py::test_archive_publication_order_survives_inverted_scheduling[host_first-2]`
failed once under `just check`'s full parallel lane and then passed on two reruns of the
same unchanged tree — serially and under isolated xdist. Proposed by epic land agent
sase-s8.land while landing epic sase-s8 (`sase agent wait`); the failure is unrelated to
that epic's diff.

Only the `[host_first-2]` param failed; the five sibling params of the same test passed
in the same lane, and the rest of the 36354-node suite passed. The failing lane's
traceback was not captured, so the first job here is capturing it with
`just test-contention` before changing anything.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Discovered while landing epic sase-s8 (`sase agent wait`) in workspace sase_12 on 2026-08-23.

FAIL: one `just check` run at HEAD 2e0ac0f37 plus a two-line diff (restore the public
name `is_terminal_state` in src/sase/agent/wait_watch/_types.py, drop one stale
`--epic-symbol` line from the Justfile). The scoped lane escalated to the whole suite and
reported `1 failed, 36354 passed, 12 skipped in 449.27s`, with
`tests/test_plan_approval_launch_reliability_integration.py::test_archive_publication_order_survives_inverted_scheduling[host_first-2]`
as the only failure. Nothing in that diff touches plan approval, launch admission,
publication queues, or the artifact archive, so my tree did not cause it.

PASS (same tree, no edits in between):
- serial rerun of the whole parametrized node:
  `.venv/bin/python -m pytest "tests/test_plan_approval_launch_reliability_integration.py::test_archive_publication_order_survives_inverted_scheduling" -q`
  -> 6 passed in 11.81s (all six host_first/poller_first x 0-2 params).
- isolated parallel rerun of the whole file:
  `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_plan_approval_launch_reliability_integration.py -n 12 -q -p no:randomly`
  -> 11 passed in 5.81s.

FAIL RATE: 1 of 1 observed full-parallel-lane runs; 0 of 2 reruns (one serial, one
isolated xdist). Does not reproduce serially and does not reproduce under xdist when the
file runs alone, so this looks like whole-suite contention rather than an in-file
ordering bug. The three sibling params of the same test passed in the same failing lane,
which points at a timing/scheduling assertion rather than a logic error.

CAVEAT: the failing lane's traceback was not captured (the run's tail was read after the
short summary), so the specific assertion is not yet known. Whoever works this should
first reproduce with `just test-contention` on this node to capture it.

TEST UNDER REPORT: `test_archive_publication_order_survives_inverted_scheduling` exercises
approved-plan archive publication ordering under inverted host/poller scheduling; the file
came from epic sase-s2 (`plan:202608/plan_approval_launch_reliability.md`, closed).
